sections.title: Explanation
sections.content: Yes/no questions can use the same basic word order with question intonation. Question words such as ki, mi, *hol*, mit and miért introduce information questions.

Notice Dolgozol? uses exactly the same word order as a statement — Hungarian yes/no questions are made by intonation alone, not by flipping the verb and subject the way English does (‘You work’ → ‘Do you work?’). On the page the only clue is the question mark; out loud, it’s your rising pitch doing all the work.
